title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: ICT and security
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Communications containment and cabling in risers and ceilings
swms.task: Install cable tray and pull structured data cabling in the risers, corridor ceilings and apartments, drilling into the post-tensioned slabs for tray anchors, working from scissor lifts more than 2 m above the floor, and from platform ladders for lower work.

facts.fallControl: Risers are screened at each level with only the section being worked on opened, scissor lifts with guardrails are used for all work above 2 m, and platform ladders only for work below 2 m.
facts.silicaControls: Anchor holes are drilled with on-tool dust extraction. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn while drilling. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.

steps: Install containment and pull communications cabling

swms.title: Optical fibre backbone installation, splicing and testing
swms.task: Install the optical fibre backbone cabling in the risers from the main comms room in the basement to each floor, then splice and test the fibre.

facts.fallControl: Riser openings have fixed edge protection screens at each level, with only the section being worked on opened, and gates closed when not in use.

steps: Install containment and pull communications cabling
Install, splice and test optical fibre

swms.title: Comms rooms, racks and UPS batteries
swms.task: Install communications racks, cabinets and UPS batteries in the basement comms room and the floor comms rooms, and terminate the data cabling.

steps: Install racks, cabinets and UPS batteries in the comms rooms

swms.title: CCTV, access control and intercoms
swms.task: Install CCTV cameras, access control card readers and intercoms in the foyer, lift lobbies and the 3 basement car park levels, working from scissor lifts more than 2 m above the floor, and from platform ladders for lower work, while other trades' vehicles use the car park.

facts.fallControl: Scissor lifts with guardrails are used for all work above 2 m, and platform ladders only for work below 2 m.

swms.title: Roof antennas and MATV
swms.task: Install the MATV antennas and the communications cabling on the roof, next to the roof edge.

facts.fallControl: Edge protection is installed around the roof perimeter before work starts, and no one works outside it.

steps: Install plant and equipment on the roof
